title: RankBuffer: Efficient Ranking-Based Rewards for Open-Ended Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.36652v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Open-ended generation lacks canonical answers, making pointwise rewards difficult to calibrate for group-based reinforcement learning. Directly ranking same-query rollouts provides a more suitable relative reward signal, but existing ranking-based reward methods can incur substantial judging cost. We introduce RankBuffer, which maintains an ordered, query-specific buffer of previously judged responses as a reusable quality scale. Each rollout is first inserted into an anchor interval through an independent coarse judgment, after which only rollouts assigned to the same interval undergo local fine ranking. The resulting complete order is converted into bounded rank rewards, while boundary expansion, local refinement, and inactive-anchor pruning adapt the buffer as the policy evolves. Across four open-ended benchmarks, RankBuffer consistently outperforms all pointwise baselines. It also achieves nearly on-par performance with the strongest

translated_title: RankBuffer：面向开放式生成的高效排序奖励方法
translated_abstract: 开放式生成缺乏标准答案，使得逐点奖励在基于分组的强化学习中难以校准。直接对同一查询的多个生成结果进行排序能够提供更合适的相对奖励信号，但现有的基于排序的奖励方法会带来巨大的评判成本。我们提出 RankBuffer，它维护一个有序的、针对特定查询的已评判响应缓冲区，作为可复用的质量标尺。每个生成结果首先通过独立的粗略评判被插入到某个锚点区间中，随后只有被分配到同一区间的结果才进行局部精细排序。由此得到的完整排序被转换为有界的排名奖励，同时通过边界扩展、局部细化和非活跃锚点剪枝，使缓冲区随着策略的演进而自适应调整。在四个开放式基准测试中，RankBuffer 始终优于所有逐点基线方法，并且取得了与最强方法几乎相当的性能
tldr: 提出 RankBuffer，将已评判响应的有序缓冲区作为可复用质量标尺，通过粗锚点插入加局部精细排序的两阶段方式，在大幅降低评判成本的同时为开放式生成提供高效的排序奖励。
en_tdlr: RankBuffer maintains an ordered, query-specific buffer of previously judged responses as a reusable quality scale, using coarse anchor insertion followed by local fine ranking to deliver efficient ranking-based rewards for open-ended generation at substantially reduced judging cost.
